evidence.name: Screen field: When the close button appears
evidence.userNeed: Know what "When the close button appears" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: When the close button appears
sections.description: Controls when the X becomes tappable: right away, or after a short timer that lets users take in the offer first (set the length in the delay field below). For ad traffic, showing it immediately or after a 2-3 second delay converts well without feeling like a trap. Avoid long delays that frustrate users or break ad-network rules.
